title: Synthetic linguistic data
abstract: arXiv:2610.34215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synthetic linguistic data have become increasingly prominent in linguistic research, from the analysis of large collections of AI-generated texts to controlled experiments investigating grammatical and lexical preferences. This glossary entry extends Bresnan's (2016) distinction between the linguistic garden and the bush by introducing an artificial plant nursery as a metaphor for synthetic data. We distinguish between synthetic bush data, consisting primarily of corpus-like collections of model-generated language, and synthetic garden data, in which model outputs are elicited under controlled conditions to investigate specific linguistic hypotheses. We argue that synthetic data constitute a distinct object of linguistic investigation: comparing them with natural language data can reveal both shared patterns and divergences, but their interpretation requires careful consideration of the conditions under which they are generated.

translated_abstract: 合成语言数据在语言学研究中日益凸显，应用范围涵盖从对大规模AI生成文本集合的分析，到调查语法和词汇偏好的受控实验。本术语词条扩展了Bresnan（2016）对“语言学花园”与“灌木丛”的区分，引入“人工植物苗圃”作为合成数据的隐喻。我们区分了两类数据：合成灌木丛数据，主要由类似语料库的模型生成语言集合构成；以及合成花园数据，即在受控条件下引出模型输出以检验特定语言学假设。我们论证，合成数据构成一个独特的语言学研究对象：将其与自然语言数据进行比较既能揭示共同模式，也能显现差异，但对这些数据的解读需要仔细考虑其生成条件。
tldr: 本文提出“人工植物苗圃”隐喻，将合成语言数据分为“合成灌木丛数据”（类语料库的模型生成语言集合）和“合成花园数据”（受控条件下引出的模型输出），论证合成数据是独特的语言学研究对象，其解读须考虑生成条件。
en_tdlr: This glossary entry introduces an "artificial plant nursery" metaphor to distinguish synthetic bush data (corpus-like collections of model-generated language) from synthetic garden data (model outputs elicited under controlled conditions), arguing that synthetic data constitute a distinct object of linguistic investigation whose interpretation requires careful consideration of generation conditions.
